newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Power Senoko opens $450mln power plant.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Power Senoko opens $450mln power plant.

text.p: Power Senoko, a subsidiary of state power monopoly Singapore Power, on Tuesday opened its first combined cycle plant (CCP), costing Singapore $450 million.

Power Senoko chairman Peter Seah Lim Huat said at the opening ceremony that: "The capital costs will be recouped in the long run through lower fuel costs. This will enable us to eventually pass on cost savings to consumers."
The CCP will raise Senoko Power Station's generation capacity to 2,460 Megawatt(MW) from 2,134 MW.
Seah later told reporters the company plans to diversify beyond its core business of power generation.
He said the new business includes the production of "steam demineralised water for supply to industrial users."
"Beyond power generation, the company has a lot of other assets which can be exploited to diversify in revenue," said Seah.

Power Senoko was formally known as PowerGen Senoko. Seah said with the new name, "Power Senoko is ready to extend its capability beyond just power generation... we will begin to explore new business." -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
